capabilities: Localize web, pasted, dragged, and base64 images into the vault
Rename attachments with time-plus-MD5 names and deduplicate them
Clear unused images, unused attachments, and unlinked attachments
Compress images to WebP or JPEG
Jump from an image to its source note
disambiguation: Not an image-hosting or embedding service; it manages image and attachment files stored in the vault.
extras: README advises backing up the vault before batch processing, cleanup, or large-scale link rewriting; installation is by manually copying the plugin folder into .obsidian/plugins/.
problem: Obsidian leaves pasted and web-linked images outside the vault and offers no built-in way to rename media systematically or find attachments that are no longer referenced.
summary: Attachment manager that downloads web and pasted images into the vault, renames media files, and deletes unused attachments.
